name: Flanders Nature Center Summer Camp & Academies
description_short: Nature camps for ages 3 to 13 at Flanders Nature Center in Woodbury, run as half days (9am-1pm or 1-5pm) or all day (9am-5pm), with before care from 8am. Programs include nature exploration, farm animal care, art, cooking, youth environmental leadership and science academies.
refund_policy_summary: Cancel more than 4 weeks before your first camp day for a full refund, or 3 to 4 weeks before for a 50% refund. A 6.83% processing fee comes off both. There is no refund within 21 days of the start date, no pro-rating for missed days, and no refund if a camper is dismissed for behavior. If the camp cancels a session, families get a full refund or can transfer.

sources.note: 2026 season; groups follow the grade entered in fall 2026. Before care 'Rooster Roll Call' 8-9 AM. Camperships available. No base prices on the site; all-day discount $38/week, member family membership $75.
2026 Summer Camp at a Glance: twelve weeks, June 8 to August 28, 2026, with a theme per program each week.
